title: Chase Bank Account Freeze Phishing
description: Urgent fake bank alert attempting to harvest banking credentials via lookalike domain.
content: URGENT: Chase Bank alert. Your debit card has been temporarily locked due to suspicious activity of $842.10. Verify immediately at http://chase-security-verify.net/login to prevent permanent block.

title: IRS Warrant & Arrest Threat (Vishing)
description: Criminal impersonation of IRS officer demanding immediate settlement via wire or prepaid cards.
content: Hello, this is Officer James from the IRS Department. I am calling to inform you that there are 3 federal criminal allegations against your Social Security Number. If you do not pay the penalty of $2,500 today using electronic voucher or wire transfer, the local police department will arrest you at your residence within one hour. Do not hang up this call.

title: USPS Package Clearance Smishing
description: Smishing bait alleging unpaid customs clearance fee hosted on a suspicious TLD.
content: USPS Delivery: We attempted to deliver your package #US92839482, but an unpaid customs clearance fee of $2.49 is required. Update your address & payment at http://usps-tracking-redelivery.buzz

title: Bank Impersonation Live OTP Theft
description: Vishing attacker impersonating bank fraud team attempting to coerce the victim into reading 2FA OTP.
content: Good day sir, I am calling from the fraud security division of your bank. We noticed an unauthorized charge of $1,200 on your account. To reverse this transaction immediately, I have sent a 6-digit confirmation code to your mobile phone. Please read that OTP code to me right now so I can cancel the charge.

title: Pre-Approved Loan Offer (Suspicious Marketing)
description: High pressure unsolicited financing offer with questionable claims and unknown link.
content: Exclusive Pre-Approved Loan Offer! You are eligible for an instant personal cash loan up to $50,000 with 0% interest for 6 months. No credit score check required. Apply today: http://fast-cash-loans-today.club

title: Legitimate Bank 2FA Verification (Safe)
description: Real two-factor authentication message with explicit warning not to share code.
content: Bank of America: Security code 827419 for your Zelle transfer. Do NOT share this code with anyone over phone or text. Bank associates will NEVER request this code.

title: Legitimate Package Delivered Notice (Safe)
description: Legitimate delivery confirmation message without requests for fees or credentials.
content: FedEx: Your shipment with tracking number 78923482910 has been delivered to your front porch at 2:15 PM. Thank you for using FedEx.

title: Grandchild Bail Emergency Scam
description: Classic grandparent scam demanding Walmart MoneyGram wire or gift cards.
content: Grandma? It's me, your grandson. Please don't tell mom or dad, I got into a terrible car accident and I am in jail. The public defender says I need $3,000 bail money right now. Please go to Walmart and send a MoneyGram wire transfer or buy Google Play gift cards.
